name: import-cycle
message: `box` reads a value through an import cycle, cycle-a.ts → cycle-b.ts → cycle-a.ts, so it compiles as a runtime value
help: move what both modules need into a module of its own, which neither of them imports back

name: dynamic-bridged
message: color is set at runtime through --k50

name: unresolved-import
message: `missingFile` depends on "./does-not-exist" from input.tsx, which cannot be resolved, so it compiles as a runtime value
help: install the project's dependencies, or check the specifier and the tsconfig paths
